outline: This course teaches students the estimations of time and cost when managing a project, the development of project schedule and budget, and other relevant skills in monitoring and controlling the project. The feasibility study of project investment, project risk assessment, project interface management, and the role of project manager in a project team within an organization will also be discussed.
schedule:
1    Introduction (course outline and class teaching notes)
Concept and definition of “project”
2    Project management applications and certifications
3    WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) and activity list
Project network representation (AOA and AON)
4    Project scheduling based on Gantt chart
Identification of critical path(s)
5    Project scheduling based on AOA, AON and matrix
6    National Holiday (No class)
7    Project budgeting and cost control
8    Project investment feasibility and selection criteria
9    Mid-term exam
10  Project risk management
11  Project interface management
12  Project crashing (time and cost tradeoffs) I
13  Project crashing (time and cost tradeoffs) II
14  Class presentation I
15  Class presentation II
16  Class presentation III
17  Class presentation IV
18  Class presentation V
